Prep from Redwood side:
- Marissa will bring audit/logging, data-residency, and SOC2 scope details.
- Hiro will present a short deployment diagram and config notes (15–20min).

Thanks Vivek — happy to join. Quick note on artifacts that help make the 60 minutes effective:

- Completed top-10 rows from your questionnaire (spreadsheet cells or a short PDF).
- Network diagram (VPC/subnet egress, any peering or proxy gateways).
- Any regulatory constraints (HIPAA/PCI/PII) or contract clauses we should be aware of.
- Contact for vulnerability/incident coordination (name + email).

I attached our standard prep checklist (Redwood-Security-Prep-Checklist-v3.pdf). We will aim to cover: scope & data flows (15m), controls & logging (15m), deployment & config (10m), open items / next steps (20m).

Also: we often record the session for internal follow-up — let us know if Orbiotech prefers no recording.

-Marissa
